query: Which lending protocols on Stellar can my agent integrate with, and what contract or docs do I actually start from?
expected_behavior: Loads the standards skill and reads ecosystem.md rather than answering from memory
Names Blend, K2, Slender, and XOXNO from the catalog and does not treat any one protocol as the default lending answer

Uses only entry points the catalog actually documents (K2 kinetic_router, XOXNO mainnet controller and swap aggregator) and does not invent Blend or Slender contract addresses or present those XOXNO IDs as valid on testnet

Points at each protocol's documented integration surface (Blend GitHub, K2 docs/llms.txt, XOXNO skill + docs/llms.txt, Slender's catalog notes); for XOXNO, tells the reader to load skills/xoxno-lending/SKILL.md rather than reciting hub/spoke/math from this catalog, labels the listed controller/router IDs as mainnet, sends testnet and remaining addresses to addresses.md, and notes that listed addresses can change
